mixed_pyramidal_3_warm.xml:
<mujoco model="mixed_rows">
  <option timestep="0.002" solver="PGS" cone="pyramidal">
    <flag island="disable"/>
  </option>
  <worldbody>
    <geom type="plane" size="5 5 0.1"/>
    <body name="arm" pos="0 0 1">
      <joint name="h" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" limited="true" range="-0.3 0.3"
             frictionloss="0.5" damping="0.1"/>
      <geom type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0.3 0 0" size="0.02" mass="1" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
    </body>
    <body name="ball" pos="0.3 0 1">
      <freejoint/>
      <geom type="sphere" size="0.05" mass="0.5" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
    </body>
    <body name="puck" pos="1 0 0.0995">
      <freejoint/>
      <geom type="sphere" size="0.1" mass="1" friction="0.8 0.02 0.002" condim="3"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
  <equality>
    <connect body1="arm" body2="ball" anchor="0.3 0 0"/>
  </equality>
</mujoco>

<mujoco model="mixed_rows">
  <option timestep="0.002" solver="PGS" noslip_iterations="10" cone="pyramidal">
    <flag island="disable"/>
  </option>
  <worldbody>
    <geom type="plane" size="5 5 0.1"/>
    <body name="arm" pos="0 0 1">
      <joint name="h" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" limited="true" range="-0.3 0.3"
             frictionloss="0.5" damping="0.1"/>
      <geom type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0.3 0 0" size="0.02" mass="1" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
    </body>
    <body name="ball" pos="0.3 0 1">
      <freejoint/>
      <geom type="sphere" size="0.05" mass="0.5" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
    </body>
    <body name="puck" pos="1 0 0.0995">
      <freejoint/>
      <geom type="sphere" size="0.1" mass="1" friction="0.8 0.02 0.002" condim="3"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
  <equality>
    <connect body1="arm" body2="ball" anchor="0.3 0 0"/>
  </equality>
</mujoco>

  <option gravity="0 0 0" timestep="0.001" iterations="100" solver="PGS" jacobian="sparse">
    <flag island="disable"/>
  </option>
  <worldbody>
    <geom name="floor" type="plane" size="10 10 0.1" euler="10 0 0"/>
    <body name="box" pos="0 0 0.2">
      <joint type="free"/>
      <geom type="box" size="0.3 0.3 0.3"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
</mujoco>

PGS_mixed_pyramidal_3_slide.xml:
<mujoco model="mixed_rows">
  <option timestep="0.002" solver="PGS" cone="pyramidal">
    <flag island="disable"/>
  </option>
  <worldbody>
    <geom type="plane" size="5 5 0.1"/>
    <body name="arm" pos="0 0 1">
      <joint name="h" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" limited="true" range="-0.3 0.3"
             frictionloss="0.5" damping="0.1"/>
      <geom type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0.3 0 0" size="0.02" mass="1" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
    </body>
    <body name="ball" pos="0.3 0 1">
      <freejoint/>
      <geom type="sphere" size="0.05" mass="0.5" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
    </body>
    <body name="puck" pos="1 0 0.0995">
      <freejoint/>
      <geom type="sphere" size="0.1" mass="1" friction="0.8 0.02 0.002" condim="3"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
  <equality>
    <connect body1="arm" body2="ball" anchor="0.3 0 0"/>
  </equality>
</mujoco>
